interpretation.activation_peak: Pulse time and temperature transition are confounded in protocol A; activation_peak_h is delayed biological activation, not a uniquely identified nitrogen-response time.
interpretation.line_reservoir: A fitted time constant above an engineering residence-time measurement is phenomenological and cannot be labeled physical line holdup.
interpretation.external_validation: All six runs have informed model development; leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation, not prospective confirmation.

literature_basis.transfer: Morakul et al. 2011, DOI 10.1016/j.procbio.2011.01.034; Mouret et al. 2014, DOI 10.1016/j.foodres.2014.02.044
